bibl.title: "Nonsense Burners" and Nomads.
bibl.seg: Robert K. Ritner (ed.), Essays for the Library of Seshat. Studies Presented to Janet H. Johnson on the Occasion of Her 70th Birthday = Studies in Ancient Oriental Civilization. 70 (Chicago, 2017) pp. 171-181, figg.
bibl.note: Four small box-like (rectangular with a shallow depression on top) items carved from very soft stone and more or less elaborately decorated, as well as one mud-brick with a similar depression on top: these could be miniature altars used for water offerings, and might be associated with the desert nomads.
